name: Add On Sales
query:
SELECT
	`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name AS "Add-on Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
	COUNT(`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.name) AS "Sold Count:Int:150"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`
LEFT JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`
	ON `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.item = `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name
GROUP BY `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name
ORDER BY COUNT(`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.name) DESC
